title: Rocket School
tagline: Race the computer to a planet by answering maths, French, English, history and typing questions; four games, one learner model.
readinessNote: The curriculum is data: 108 skills in one JSON list (Data/Curriculum), 26 explainer cards and every word on screen in two more. A fact bank needs no code at all; a new kind of generated question is one function in Logic/Pick next question. Star Class, beside it, is the same game re-cut for another school system.
buildYourOwn: Your own school: other classes, subjects, question banks and explainers, another language for the interface, new rocket parts for the hangar.
controls: Mouse or touch; the keyboard for typed answers and the arrow keys in Make Ten Merge
licence: GPL-3.0 for the project (as in the NodeGX repository it came from); MIT for the NodeGX runtime in play/; assets as listed in CREDITS.md
